subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is carried up the stairs by Dren's mercenaries after being severely injured in the fight against the wraith.
source_quote: The man was being carried. Hands had me. Many hands, rough hands, the wrong hands — Dren's people, hauling me up off the marble by the arms and the plate, my heels dragging across the brown stone with its black veins, my mace knocking against someone's shin.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is described as a cleric who cannot say his god's name in the temple, causing his prayers to come out as complaints.
source_quote: Calmer wasn't a worrier. He just couldn't say his own god's name in here, so it came out sideways, as complaint.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is placed upstairs under the care of Dren's mercenaries to prevent him from re-entering the fight.
source_quote: Deeply injured, parked with Dren's mercenaries somewhere behind a curtain so he wouldn't get himself killed reaching for a god he can't name in here.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr leads the group into the Air Temple after Calmer is removed from the party.
source_quote: Calmer wasn't with us. ... I had the others. And I had the only thing in this temple that ever told me the truth: four starving prophets...

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr says 'Let's go export' when entering the Air Temple, a phrase nobody corrects.
source_quote: "Let's go export," I said, which is not how the word goes, but nobody corrected me, and we went.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr asks Kelno if he is for or against 'the pimple,' referring to the current power structure.
source_quote: "Kelno," I said. "So — are you for or against? The pimple." My mouth tripped over the word and I let it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr fumbles the suggestion to leave Dren with Kelno, then corrects himself upon remembering Calmer is upstairs.
source_quote: You could stay here with — what's his name. Kelno." Then he caught himself. Calmer was upstairs. We took him up. "Oh. Shit."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia expresses suspicion toward Kelno during the negotiation in the Air Temple.
source_quote: "We have to be suspicious of him," Zinnia said.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia responds to Kelno's offer by saying, "We sit there silently and menacingly," and is acknowledged for the menace.
source_quote: "Yeah," Sequoia said. "We sit there silently and menacingly." He appreciated the menace.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia declares that the group are the victors after realizing they have manipulated the temple war.
source_quote: "We are the victors," Sequoia said.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren carries Calmer up two flights of brown marble stairs after the battle with the wraith.
source_quote: Dren had carried him up two flights of brown marble and the thanks he wanted was to be heard out about it.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren reports that Belsornig's people are at the captain's door and that Alrrem is on his pyre.
source_quote: "The captain, the captain? March is finished." Dren said it fast, the way men say things they ran to deliver. "Belsornig's people are at his door. He's screaming for you." ... "Alrrem's on his pyre," he went on.

subject: Dren
fact: Dren states that he was not put in charge of mercenaries and that he only follows orders.
source_quote: "You didn't put me in charge of mercenaries, because I tell you what to do." He shrugged, a soldier's shrug. "You tell me."

subject: Dren
fact: Dren is instructed to stay behind with Calmer and guard him with his mercenaries.
source_quote: "Take your mercenaries and stay back," Zephyr landed on, finally.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno is an old cultist who offers Zephyr a deal to become his number two and take control of his goblins and informants.
source_quote: Or I could walk out with him as my number two. His goblins, mine. His informants, mine. The throne, mine. His little office, his.

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno admits his guards are the worst in the dungeon and that he could easily be killed.
source_quote: I could kill him — worst guards in the dungeon, he admitted it himself — and then walk into the deep temple blind...

subject: Kelno
fact: Kelno keeps a ledger detailing payments to a dozen names and a note saying "set out the second chair," placed two weeks prior.
source_quote: A ledger. Payments out to a dozen names. And a little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: Belsornig
fact: Belsornig is targeted by an assassination plot and is pulling his treasury out via the south route.
source_quote: Belsornig — *by the cannon of the crushing wave*, the man liked the name — the assassination plot against Hartsch... ... Belsornig pulling his treasury out the south route.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is assassinated by agents who reached his antechamber an hour prior to the meeting with Kelno.
source_quote: Assassins had reached Hartsch's antechamber an hour ago. By tonight our puppet would be meat.

subject: Alrrem
fact: Alrrem is already on his pyre when Dren reports to Sequoia.
source_quote: Alrrem's on his pyre," he went on.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag was killed at his own table by the group's prior actions.
source_quote: We took bribes from the Fire Temple, sold a chimera, knifed Romag at his own table, and pointed three armies at each other until they marched.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple chamber contains gray carpet, gray plaster, gray hangings, two upholstered chairs, a crock half-full of mead, dull metal lamps, shelves with scrolls and foodstuffs, and human and demi-human skulls arranged on the shelves.
source_quote: Everything gray. Carpet, plaster, hangings, two upholstered chairs, a crock half-full of mead, lamps of dull metal throwing barely enough light to see by. And on the shelves between the scrolls and the foodstuffs — skulls. Human, demi-human, arranged like a man arranges things he's stopped thinking about.

subject: Air Temple
fact: The Air Temple chamber has a narrow bed in the corner.
source_quote: A narrow bed in the corner.

subject: crock
fact: A crock half-full of mead is present on a table in the Air Temple chamber.
source_quote: a crock half-full of mead

subject: skulls
fact: Human and demi-human skulls are arranged on shelves between scrolls and foodstuffs in the Air Temple chamber.
source_quote: on the shelves between the scrolls and the foodstuffs — skulls. Human, demi-human, arranged like a man arranges things he's stopped thinking about.

subject: ledger
fact: Kelno keeps a ledger detailing payments to a dozen names in the Air Temple.
source_quote: A ledger. Payments out to a dozen names.

subject: note
fact: A note reading "set out the second chair" is found in Kelno's possession, dated two weeks prior.
source_quote: a little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.

subject: second chair
fact: Kelno placed a second chair in his chamber two weeks ago and sat across from it, waiting for Zephyr's group.
source_quote: He'd put the chair out two weeks ago and sat across from it, waiting for us.

subject: wraith
fact: Calmer killed a wraith twice with holy radiance before finally destroying it on the third attempt.
source_quote: Twice it had laughed at the holy power I called down in His name. Twice the holy radiance had hit the wraith and simply ceased — ... and twice I had felt the outrage of it — ... I had called the light one final time and it had answered. The chamber went white. The wraith came apart.

subject: gnoll
fact: A gnoll was charred and its smell had been hanging in the corridors all morning.
source_quote: Somewhere south of us the smell of charred gnoll had been hanging in the corridors all morning

subject: Dren's mercenaries
fact: Dren's mercenaries are tasked with protecting Calmer and preventing him from returning to the fight.
source_quote: because they had been told to keep the boss from getting himself killed.

subject: Dren's mercenaries
fact: Dren's mercenaries are described as non-stealthy, with clatter and loud breathing.
source_quote: The mercenaries are anything but stealthy, all clatter and breathing

subject: Calmer's injury
fact: Calmer is severely injured during the battle with the wraith and is rendered unable to stand without assistance.
source_quote: with nothing left in me but reflex and the body's last argument against lying down

subject: wraith's destruction
fact: The wraith is destroyed when Calmer calls holy radiance for the third time, turning the chamber white.
source_quote: I had called the light one final time and it had answered. The chamber went white. The wraith came apart.

subject: Kelno's offer
fact: Kelno offers Zephyr control of his goblins, informants, and the throne in exchange for becoming his number two.
source_quote: Or I could walk out with him as my number two. His goblins, mine. His informants, mine. The throne, mine. His little office, his.

subject: Zephyr accepts Kelno's deal
fact: Zephyr accepts Kelno's offer and agrees not to kill him for the intelligence provided.
source_quote: I cut up the mercenaries," I said. "Yes, I'll take the deal. We won't kill you for his news.

subject: Belsornig's assassination attempt
fact: An assassination plot against Hartsch is carried out by Belsornig's agents via the north service hall.
source_quote: Belsornig — *by the cannon of the crushing wave*, the man liked the name — the assassination plot against Hartsch, two men through the north service hall, the bar that should've been left unset.

subject: Hartsch's death
fact: Hartsch is assassinated by agents who reached his antechamber an hour before Kelno's meeting.
source_quote: Assassins had reached Hartsch's antechamber an hour ago. By tonight our puppet would be meat.

subject: Alrrem's cremation
fact: Alrrem is already on his pyre when Dren reports to Sequoia.
source_quote: Alrrem's on his pyre," he went on.

subject: Belsornig's treasury removal
fact: Belsornig is removing his treasury via the south route as the temple war escalates.
source_quote: Belsornig pulling his treasury out the south route.

subject: Dren's reassignment
fact: Dren and his two mercenaries are ordered to stay behind and guard Calmer upstairs.
source_quote: "Take your mercenaries and stay back," Zephyr landed on, finally.

subject: One of you is going to die today
fact: The wraith declares, "one of you is going to die today," a phrase echoed by Calmer in his delirium.
source_quote: the wraith had agreed with him — *one of you is going to die today*

subject: One of you is going to die today
fact: Calmer repeats the phrase "one of you is going to die today" quietly to himself as he is carried away, but does not believe it applies to him.
source_quote: *One of you is going to die today.* The cold sat in my chest and did not leave. *But not me.* I didn't even believe it.

subject: temple stairs
fact: The temple stairs are made of brown marble with black veins, and Calmer's heels drag across them as he is carried.
source_quote: my heels dragging across the brown stone with its black veins

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple has a secret door that was cracked open by gnolls weeks prior and was the group's intended destination.
source_quote: The secret door the gnolls had cracked open for us, the one we'd marked weeks ago

subject: Water Temple
fact: The Water Temple is lightly guarded and identified by Kelno as a good target for attack.
source_quote: He pointed us toward the Water Temple — lightly guarded now, he observed, as good a time as any to strike.

subject: two weeks ago
fact: Two weeks ago, Kelno set out the second chair in his chamber and waited for the group's arrival.
source_quote: a little note that said *set out the second chair* — two weeks old.
